headings.usage: Use for all H1-H4. Never use Inter for headings.

body.usage: Use for all paragraphs, labels, and lists.

data.usage: Use for financial numbers, metrics, and code snippets.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl with bg-black/40 (dark) or bg-white/70 (light) + 1px border. Never use pure transparent backgrounds for headers/dropdowns.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-border. Cards should not have shadows in dark mode; use surface lightness for elevation.
visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-lg for components, rounded-xl for cards, rounded-2xl for modals. Keep it clean and consistent.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient diffuse shadows for light mode. Zero shadows for dark mode, rely on border and background lightness.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle grain texture overlay for marketing pages or login background.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or sharp (rounded-lg) with smooth hover transitions (bg and text color change).
components.cards: Dense styling, 1px border, subtle background shift on hover.
components.inputs: Use Shadcn customized inputs. Dark mode inputs should be bg-zinc-900 border-zinc-800 focus:border-indigo-500.
components.tables: Dense, grid-lines visible on bottom border only. Hover state on rows.
components.charts: Recharts with custom tooltips, use accent colors and gradients that fade into the background.

grids.dashboard_bento: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-4 or gap-6. Stretch items using h-full.
grids.marketing_tetris: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8 for landing/marketing pages.

layouts.spacing: Generous. p-6 or p-8 for inner card padding. gap-6 for form elements.
layouts.alignment: Left-align dense content/data. Center-align only hero sections if needed.
layouts.navigation: Sidebar for Dashboard/Admin. Sticky Glassmorphism Header for Website Builder/Marketing.

motion.transitions: Specific property transitions (e.g., transition-colors duration-200, transition-transform). NO 'transition-all'.
motion.interactions: Hover states must increase brightness/contrast. Buttons scale slightly (active:scale-95).
motion.page_load: Staggered fade-in and slide-up (translate-y-4) for dashboard widgets.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure > 4.5:1 for text. Hover states must have explicitly defined text colors.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='sidebar-nav-link').

media.icons: lucide-react for standard dashboard icons. @phosphor-icons/react for marketing/high-end UI.
media.images: Images must have max-h-[80vh] on mobile. Dark overlays (bg-black/40) for text-on-image.

3d_libraries.usage: Use Recharts for Data analytics. No Heavy 3D required for strict OS dash unless marketing pages.

image_urls.description: Abstract dark geometric background for Login/Register page or Hero section.
Modern tech office team for HR module or About Us.
Group using laptop for CRM or Collaboration headers.
Male professional headshot for Founder/User avatar.
Female professional headshot for Client/Employee avatar.
Minimalistic split geometric background for Design Studio or creative placeholders.

general_ui_ux_design_guidelines: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Use the distinct Premium SaaS/Linear aesthetic.
Do not use pure black (#000000) or pure white (#FFFFFF) for backgrounds. Use tinted greys (#09090B).
Never use generic centered layouts for dashboards. Use High Density Bento Grids.
Create depth through border colors and background lightness in dark mode, not heavy shadows.
Never use `transition: all`. Target specific properties.
Never center-align the app container globally (`.App { text-align: center; }` is forbidden).
Never use AI assistant emoji characters for icons. Use Phosphor or Lucide icons.
Always ensure hover states have higher contrast and explicitly defined text colors.
Do not use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
instructions_to_main_agent: NOTE: The codebase uses .js files, NOT .tsx. Provide all React components as standard .jsx/.js files.
Implement WebBuilder OS primarily in Dark Mode using the color tokens provided.
Ensure `data-testid` is added to ALL interactive elements (buttons, nav links, inputs).
Use standard HTML/Tailwind for marketing/creative layouts. Use Shadcn components for complex logic.
Override default Shadcn styles to match the borderless, tight-spacing, premium dark aesthetic.
Do not use generic font Inter for headings. Ensure `Outfit` is loaded.
Build the dashboard layouts using a Bento Grid approach with dense data widgets.
Use the provided image URLs to replace any placeholders. Never use via.placeholder.com or similar.
Ensure the Design Studio and Admin Portal have sticky navigation and clear visual hierarchy.
